title: Yellow Smoked Slovakian Chicken Stew
description: A rich and hearty Slovakian stew featuring chicken breast, smoked to perfection, served in a fondue pot, perfect for a lazy Sunday. This dish is nut-free and friendly for all to enjoy.
instructions: In the fondue pot, heat the chicken broth over medium heat until it starts to simmer.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes to the pot and cook for 10 minutes or until they start to tenderize.
Add the chicken breast to the pot and cook until it reaches an internal temperature of 165 degrees.
Stir in the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Reduce heat to low and let the stew simmer for 20 minutes or until the chicken is fully cooked and the vegetables are tender.
Stir in the sour cream and let it heat through.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
